global_memory_capacity: not allocated; finite local working storage and finite request windows only
hardware_status: configured cycle model; no full-datapath STA, synthesis or silicon evidence

mode_equivalence.fields: all acceptance/completion times, full trace, actual read bytes, actions, buffer/resource state; functional outputs and trajectories

model_boundary.cdc: producer completion to destination acceptance: 3 destination edges; 3 models two synchronizers plus old-state consumer
model_boundary.counter_mapping: B bins x 2 input-sign rails x original W8 two-complement bit planes (bit7=-128) x output rows
model_boundary.encoder_domain: finite FP32 group maximum <= 2**127; lower bins clamp at minimum normal; exponent-grid scaling supports subnormals
model_boundary.encoder_implementation: one fully parallel 64-lane group frontend, 64-way max tree, per-lane B-bin select and exponent-grid conversion; configured encode_latency, uncharacterized
model_boundary.encoder_storage: one raw FP32 group is overwritten in place by packed A8/sign/bin/endpoint metadata after encoding

fixture.attention_crop: last query head0, shared KV head0, 128 deterministic spread candidates; selector/QKV/RoPE timing excluded
fixture.ffn_crop: full 896 input channels; 70 intermediate outputs; 16 final outputs; first 16 true post-attention residual values; omitted intermediate outputs make this a crop, not full FFN equivalence
fixture.precision_note: Q/K projections captured after BF16 linear, RoPE applied in FP32 for exported fixture; not bitwise model-attention evidence

model_boundary.numeric: exact integer sample accumulation; FP32 tile restore/reduction; BF16 optional output
model_boundary.restore_implementation: shared vector_lanes arithmetic slots; rail subtraction and positional shifts, integer plane reduction, ordered per-bin FP32 restore/accumulate, cross-tile FP32 addition; configured pipeline depths, not characterized RTL
model_boundary.restore_rounding_scope: per-bin restoration order only; no full-FFN/encoder/exception RTL equivalence claim
model_boundary.restore_storage: packed counter banks overwritten by signed positional terms then collapsed sums; extra small-T bit growth plus 3 FP32 row vectors use finite restore scratch
model_boundary.sc_implementation: per engine parallel 64x64 W8 gating / per-bin rail-plane popcounts and counter update; configured sc_latency; no timing-closure or PPA claim
model_boundary.storage_boundary: finite local weights/counters/encoded/partial state; backing SRAM/DRAM address space has no total-capacity allocator
model_boundary.tensor_storage: FP32 input/z/partial/residual; fixed W8 plus FP32 scale; BF16 output when configured
model_boundary.trace_storage: retained threshold histories and receipts are simulator evidence, not hardware buffers
model_boundary.weight_layout: offline tile-major packed signed W8; FP32 scale read/stored separately
